messages:
devon: CI red on main -> integ/e2e (email integration). Failing consistently on "send-email.spec.ts" since ~10:22. Anyone seen this?
ci-bot: build: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/98765 -> FAIL
ci-bot: failing step: integ-e2e (node14)
ci-bot: log excerpt:
```
  Error: connect ETIMEDOUT 10.42.7.12:2525
  at TCPConnectWrap.afterConnect [as oncomplete] (net.js:1141:16)
  Caused by: connect timeout
```
maria: I saw one flaky earlier but it passed after a rerun. Could be mock-email container flapping.
andrew: @devon can you paste the full job link + commit? i'll try a quick bisect if it's deterministic.
devon: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/98765/steps/integ-e2e -> commit 3f9b7a2 (merge PR #412)
emily: putting oncall hat on. Can someone do `kubectl -n ci get pods -l app=mock-email` for the failing job pod? I want to see restarts.
olivia: here are the logs from the job agent (grabbed before it expired):
```
  mock-email-0  OOMKilled
  mock-email-1  CrashLoopBackOff (Back-off restarting failed container)
```
maria: that points to mem pressure; recent docker-compose change reduced mem_limit for mock services in CI images (PR #410). Could be related.
andrew: good call. @emily can we check node alloc + kube eviction events?
emily: ran on the job node: 
```
  kubectl -n ci describe node ci-runner-7 | grep -A3 'Allocatable'
  Events:
    12:21:32  Warning  EvictionThresholdMet  kubelet  Node memory pressure
```
ci-bot: note: job env has MOCK_EMAIL_REPLICAS=1 by default.
devon: is there an easy temporary mitigation so the rest of CI isn't blocked? increase replicas or bump mem?
olivia: quick hack: pin the mock to an older image tag that uses less memory: `mock-email:v1.3.2` instead of `latest`. We did that in prod tests before.
andrew: can we do a bisect to confirm PR #410 is the cause? I'll queue a local bisect run against the affected test matrix. Anyone doing the rerun meanwhile?
maria: re-run queued in CI by @maria -> https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/98766 (rerun with longer timeouts + mem boost) :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
ci-bot: rerun triggered by maria. new build 98766 queued.
emily: action item: oncall will temporarily scale MOCK_EMAIL_REPLICAS=2 for the cluster namespace until we patch PR #410. Also will add eviction threshold alert.
devon: thanks. @andrew let us know if bisect finds PR #410 as culprit.
andrew: preliminary bisect: tests fail when base image contains change to docker-compose memory defaults. looks reproducible locally with the reduced mem_limit. I can open a revert PR or adjust mem flag.
olivia: long-term fix: add healthcheck to mock-email container and set graceful backoff + fail-open in tests so single mock blip doesn't fail entire suite.
emily: created incident ticket INFRA-2124 to track (temporary scaling + alert + follow-up).
ci-bot: build 98766 -> PASS (integ-e2e) :tada:
devon: nice, rerun green. I'll hold merging queue for 30m while we watch.
maria: follow-up PR coming to set mem_limit back to previous values for CI images and add a note in the release checklist.
andrew: also adding a tiny test shim to retry email send in the test harness (3 attempts) to reduce flakiness.
devon: thanks everyone. Closing thread once INFRA-2124 updates are merged. :thumbsup:
